notes.title: Update notes for Feb 17 2024
notes.notes:
Changes:

 Rescuing the zodiac animals in Tian Ting now involves rescuing 1 of each type of zodiac animal (rat, ox, etc)
 Move the status bars (invulnerability, being on fire, speed boost, etc) to the right side of the screen

notes.title: Update notes for Feb 9 2024
notes.notes:
Changes:

 Updated the dragon portrait to include their wings
 Changed some words in the Chinese localization text

notes.title: Update notes for Oct 26 2023
notes.notes:
Progress in the campaign is now automatically saved, and you can continue your journey later. Upon death during the campaign, you'll now return to the farm (loading your last save) instead of returning to the main menu.

You can also start a new campaign game whenever you like, if you wish to replay the campaign storyline.

Changes:

 Campaign progress is now saved
 Dying in the campaign now returns the player to the farm and loads their last saved game


Bug fixes:

 Fixed a grammatical error in the Twitch chat output

notes.title: Update notes for Oct 20 2023
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:

 Fixed a bug where Twitch viewers spawning an experience orb during the tutorial could throw an exception

notes.title: Update notes for Oct 17 2023
notes.notes:
We have added status indicators, so you can tell when you have buffs/debuffs active! In particular, invulnerability, speed boost, and being on fire now show up!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42014435/2a0473c04277e2ab38a3182cbf4b7db029ef7873.gif

Changes:

 Added status indicators for buffs/debuffs, with their durations shown in color
 Increased the max speed of loot flying towards the player
 Chats that are emote-only now automatically move forward to the next chat, unless a level starts immediately afterwards


Bug fixes:

 Fixed a bug where Pomegranate (and others) would run in place while charging an attack

notes.title: Update notes for Oct 10 2023
notes.notes:
We have reduced the difficulty setting for Cozy mode, so that players who choose that difficulty can have a relaxing playthrough of the story. Remember, our difficulty settings are fully customizable, so you can change the slider values to find the right fit for you!

Changes:

 Reduced difficulty settings for Cozy difficulty


Bug fixes:

 Twitch Pride minions should now properly spawn when the argument "pride" is given
 Twitch minions should no longer affect Butter's behavior in the tutorial

notes.title: Update notes for Sept 19 2023
notes.notes:
We have found and fixed some bugs that caused frame rate drops. With this patch, we hope that our game will now maintain a smooth (and high) frame rate. Do let us know if you encounter any more low frame rate events!

Bug fixes:

 Fixed bugs that would cause the frame rate to drop over time.
 Fixed a typo in a perk quote.
 Fixed a bug where the music did not reset after the tutorial.

notes.title: Update notes for Sept 3 2023
notes.notes:
Changes:

 Increased the damage that foxes do in the campaign. Overall, the campaign should feel somewhat more difficult now.


Bug fixes:

 Fixed a bug where the music volume would get louder when switching to/from the main menu.

notes.title: Update notes for Sept 2 2023
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:

 Fixed a localization-related bug that caused players not to be able to see any text.

notes.title: Update notes for Aug 31 2023
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42014435/2ac4c770fdf89db0dd48605a918bef6a482711f5.gif

Changes:

 The dodge action now displays its cooldown!
 At the demo level cap of 20 (the full game will not have a level cap), the experience bar now says "Max for demo"
 Dodge and interact keybinds now show up depending on the player's input types (e.g., gamepad button icons only appear if the player has a gamepad)
 Multi-player updates: quest objectives, coins collected, and dodge instructions now appear in each split-screen window


Bug fixes:

 The interact icon over Chestnut's head in the campaign should no longer be twitchy/blurry
 Fixed a bug in local multi-player character selection


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42014435/902235e1ed76992a225b23effd74e979c9e00396.gif

notes.title: Update notes for Aug 23 2023
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:

 Fixed a bug where multiple rings of runestones could spawn in the world. Now only a single set of runestones will spawn.


Changes:

 Updated the text at the beginning of the campaign about how chicks were kidnapped by foxes.
 Increased the range of interaction with other characters in the farm, but requires Peppermint to be facing in their general direction.

notes.title: Update notes for Aug 22 2023
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:

 Fixed duplicate mapping of keyboard-A; keyboard-A now only moves the player left, and is no longer also used for dodge/interact
 Fixed typos in chats and quest progress text


Changes:

 Added dots that appear at the bottom right of the interact window when text have finished appearing

notes.title: Update notes for May 28th 2023
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:

 Fixed a bug in the Twitch integration where connecting to the Twitch server could cause a freeze of up to 30 seconds


Changes:

 New loot type: shield - gives a temporary invulnerability buff
 New perk: damage reduction - similar to the permanent player buff, but as a level-up perk that lasts for that game
 The dragon mini-boss and dragon boss now cast meteors more often
 The Twitch integration now connects via SSL

notes.title: Update notes for May 26th 2023
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:

 Raccoons no longer cluck when they are damaged


Changes:

 The main menu button after victory/defeat now appears 2 seconds after the victory/defeat screen, to help prevent players from immediately returning to the main menu by mistake by hitting the gamepad button

notes.title: Update notes for May 23rd 2023
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:

 Cultists now firmly plant their feet on the ground, and should not get pushed around by other fauna
 The damage area of Chili Pfft has been adjusted to more accurately target enemies behind the player
 Alt-tabbing during the victory/defeat screen no longer causes the menu to pop up


Changes:

 Damage done by the dragon miniboss and dragon boss have been reduced, since there was a big damage spike during those levels
 The highlighting of the currently-selected perk during a level-up should now be clearer
 Players can now walk through ritual circles
 Mini-bosses and bosses no longer teleport in single-player mode, and only teleport in multi-player mode

notes.title: Update notes for May 19th 2023
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:

 Quest markers (the exclamation marks) should only appear for the active quests


Changes:

 Quest text now updates when mini-bosses and bosses spawn to reflect the boss-fighting stage
 In multi-player mode, the requirements for quests are increased, e.g., more foxes have to be killed if there are more players

notes.title: Update notes for May 12th 2023
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:

 Fixed an issue where summoned minions (e.g., cats) would follow a different player in multi-player mode.
 Status sounds (e.g., being on fire) should no longer play when the victory/defeat screen pops up
 Optimized fire trails so they should not cause significant frame drops


Changes:

 Temporary speed-up loot now drops, which increases the player's movement speed by 50% for 10 seconds
 Added a speed-up perk that increases the movement speed of the player
 Adjusted level-up perk rarity and drop rates
 Mouseover tooltips now appear in the difficulty selection menu, and the tooltips no longer disappear after a timeout
 Small rocks no longer spawn, and large rocks spawn farther apart, so players should no longer get stuck behind rocks that are hidden by trees
 Replaced "accept player(s)" with "confirm" in the player selection menu
 Updated description of the possum perk
 Players' skills should no longer activate once the victory screen pops up

notes.title: Update notes for May 9th 2023
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:

 Fixed an issue where too many fire trails would cause a significant frame drop
 Fixed a bug where status sounds (e.g., being on fire) would continue playing while the menu is open


Changes:

 Updated sound effect of airstrikes
 Added sounds for UI buttons when they are pressed
 Dodging no longer drops large eggs (for Peppermint and Kernel Popcorn) or logs (for Vanilla and Creme Brulee)
 Added a Twitch chat print when Twitch viewers spawning a health/experience orb
 Added shorter Twitch commands and aliases for viewers:

 !heal, !hp, !health to spawn a health orb
 !exp, !xp, !experience to spawn an experience orb
 !boom, !bomb, !sacrifice to sacrifice a spawned minion and do AOE damage

notes.title: Update notes for May 7th 2023
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42014435/aa1846c6cec13c2391f17ef293e912c9830ae1e7.gif

Bug fixes:

 Fixed a bug where in multi-player mode, arrows that point to players out of screen would be offset if the screen resolution was not 1920x1080


Changes:

 Updated sound effect when player is burning
 In multi-player mode, players can now revive one another by standing close by

notes.title: Update notes for May 6th 2023
notes.notes:
Changes:

 Improved player selection UI by adding more buttons and keybindings
 Added tips that show up while the game is loading
 Increased the charging speed of sheep minions
 Twitch minions now start with lower health, but upon every death, the viewer levels up, and subsequent minions are stronger
 New Twitch viewer command: !sacrifice - sacrifices a viewer's minion to do AOE damage to nearby enemies
 New Twitch viewer command: !health - spawns a health orb for the streamer
 New Twitch viewer command: !experience - spawns an experience orb for the streamer
 Updated the color of Kernel Popcorn

notes.title: Update notes for May 5th 2023
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42014435/fa8414a06b818437b7c8e20b88dfe4cc89cbc530.gif

Bug fixes:

 Fixed a visual bug where player buff options were not highlighted when using the keyboard/gamepad


Changes:

 Players can now actively dodge damage with the spacebar or gamepad buttons
 Damage done by players are now visible!
 Damage done by skills, and received from creatures now has some variance
 Coins earned from the Alpha demo are now transferred to the Beta playtest
 A sizzling sound can now be heard when players are on fire
 In-game menu pops up when the Steam overlay is activated
 Lightning bolt damage was buffed

notes.title: Update notes for May 4th 2023
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:

 Fixed a bug where perk selection menu would not show up in rare situations
 Fixed a bug where loot can drop below the ground if a player teleports


Changes:

 Menu now appears automatically when the game loses focus
 Creatures should no longer get pushed by other creatures behind them, if they are charging a skill
 In multi-player mode, (mini)-bosses now spawn near players who are still alive
 If a player teleports away during a (mini)-boss fight, the (mini)-boss will teleport to them

notes.title: Update notes for May 3rd 2023
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:

 Fixed a typo in the welcome message
 Fixed a bug where minibosses stayed in their running animation while charging an attack
 Fixed a bug where the HP of summoned minions (e.g., cats, chicks) was too low
 Fixed a bug where the player would stop accumulating experience points


Changes:

 Welcome message has been edited to suggest trying out co-op mode 😉
 Creme Brulee has been buffed and now summons 2 cat minions immediately
 Kernel Popcorn has been buffed and now summons 5 airstrike birds immediately
 Dragon Punch damage has been buffed significantly
 Buffed cat minion's damage

notes.title: Beta version coming soon!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42014435/8e987df348fc583a3288f2e22bc381003abd29d1.gif

We are hard at work preparing for the beta launch of Feisty Fauna! We will be releasing many new features, including:

 split-screen multiplayer (up to 4 players, local / Steam remote play-together)
 cat ninja minions for Vanilla
 many more skills
 customizable difficulty, so you can adjust the game to be just right for you
 damage-over-time effects (e.g., burning from fire)
 better telegraphing of attacks (e.g., a circle filling up with red)

and more!

As part of our beta launch, we will be removing the following from our demo:

 Halloween world and costumes (don't worry, they'll be back later this year!)


Going forward from our beta launch, here are some of the big features we're planning to incorporate soon:

 Honey will be playable and can charm enemies to join her side
 A roll/dodge mechanic that you can manually activate (or automatically if you prefer)
 Other status effects, e.g., freezing, slime


Do let us know (e.g., through the Steam Discussion Board) if there are any big features that you're looking forward to seeing, and/or if you're interested to playtest our beta version before it's launched!

notes.title: Twitch integration bugfix
notes.notes: We just made a small bugfix, so the game should no longer freeze if the Twitch connection gets stuck connecting. Do let us know if you notice any bugs, Twitch-related or otherwise!
